$$H_{20} = \{x^3 : x \in \mathbb{F}_{61}^\times\}.$$

There are only 3 cosets of $H_{20}$ in $\mathbb{F}_{61}^\times$, and with a translation $c \in \mathbb{F}_{61}$, any translated multiplicative cycle of size 20 is of the form:
